content.title: 2026-27 Comprehensive Plan
content.summary: In early 2026, the City of Arvada initiated its Comprehensive Planning process to create a shared vision for the community's future, addressing areas such as economic development, housing, and transportation. The new plan will be developed through collaboration with residents and stakeholders, reflecting changes since the last plan was adopted in 2014. Community engagement is encouraged, and a diverse Community Advisory Group is being formed to guide the planning efforts.
content.body:
![Graphic depiction of streetscape with a person walking past a bus, a school, a park, houses, etc.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6455 "Graphic depiction of streetscape with a person walking past a bus, a school, a park, houses, etc.")

In early 2026, the City of Arvada kicked off its next Comprehensive Planning process. Read on for information about what a Comprehensive Plan is, where we are starting from and how you can be involved in planning for our city's future.

## What is a Comprehensive Plan?

A Comprehensive Plan is a municipality's effort to create a shared vision for the future of our community. As the name suggests, it is a *comprehensive*combination of goals and policies around economic development, housing, transportation, parks and open space — all the pieces that go into making our community what it is. It is created through a collaborative process with residents, City staff, partners, elected leaders and others to guide future development.

Want to learn more? Watch the short video below for an overview of what a Comprehensive Plan does.

## Comprehensive Plan on the Inside Arvada podcast

Listen to the Inside Arvada podcast episode with long-range planner Paul Donegan discussing the Comprehensive Plan update. Use the player below or wherever you listen to podcasts, including [Buzzsprout](https://www.buzzsprout.com/2320363/episodes/19140851) (with transcript), [Apple](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/how-arvada-plans-for-the-next-20-years/id1736238466?i=1000767588093) and [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/1Poe83t3qbANl7uEdFCiiy?si=BXMNchU9TXC0DilDxSaLKA).

## 2014 Comprehensive Plan

The City's last Comprehensive Plan was adopted in 2014. It established land use patterns, set the stage for development regulations and standards, and guided the City in funding programs and capital investments by anticipating future tax revenue. Read more about the plan and how it was implemented on the [2014 Comprehensive Plan page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/307/2014-Comprehensive-Plan).

## A new blueprint

It's no secret that Arvada has changed a lot since 2014. With that in mind, the next Comprehensive Plan will create a vision for the next 10 years. Working with a consultant, the Planning Division will design the new document based on community feedback and strategic goals for the future.

## Get involved!

Your voice will be key to creating this shared vision for Arvada's future! We are developing a plan for engagement that will be as comprehensive as the Comprehensive Plan itself. Check out the [Community engagement page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1525/Community-Engagement) for an overview of how we'll be bringing you into the conversation.

### Community Advisory Group

The City team is reviewing applications for a Community Advisory Group (CAG) to guide and inform the creation of the Comprehensive Plan. We're looking for a diverse group that reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences, including homeowners, renters, business owners, local employees, nonprofit organizations, long-time and new Arvadans, and other groups. Thank you to everyone who applied; we'll share more here as the group comes together!

## Questions?

Our planning team is here to answer any questions you have about planning and the Comprehensive Plan. [Fill out this form to contact the team](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32087).
